title: stdio and HTTP answer the same, against one contract
goal: A test sends the same initialize, tools/list and tools/call messages for kb_pack, kb_search and kb_show to kb_mcp.py over stdio and to kb_http.py over POST /mcp, finds the JSON-RPC results identical, and checks the HTTP answers against _tools/fixtures/kb_mcp_contract.json, so both paths to Copilot Studio (direct, and through a host MCP server) serve one contract
